parameters.instructions: This MCP server exposes one tool, get_policy, for the OnboardAI (Aarohan Technologies) project. Given a policy topic or free-text question, it returns a structured JSON snapshot: policy_topic, title, answer (the policy text), source_document, and status (Found / Not Found). If status is "Not Found", no matching Aarohan policy exists for that topic — tell the user rather than inventing an answer. Always cite source_document when presenting the answer.

parameters.description: Given a policy topic or a free-text question (e.g. "remote_work", "how many PTO days do I get", "grievance process"), looks up the matching Aarohan Technologies policy from the OnboardAI Policies Data Table. Returns policy_topic, title, answer (the policy text), source_document, and status ("Found" or "Not Found"). If status is "Not Found", tell the user no matching policy exists rather than inventing an answer.
